references.source_file: Bíblia Livre para o Mundo (porbrbsl) Bible text

references.why: Reported speech (the note handed to Liddell), third person, rendered as prose; Bíblia Livre: “eu honrarei aos que me honram”.

note: young-readers book. The only verbatim scripture is “Pai, perdoa-lhes” (Bíblia Livre Luke 23:34). Quotation marks mirror the English (curly “ ”). Names follow the shipped pt corpus (William Carey, David Livingstone, Festo Kivengere, Billy Graham, Pandita Ramabai, Mukti, marati, Corrie ten Boom, Betsie); Eric Liddell, Idi Amin and Janani Luwum keep their usual spellings. Carey's motto is rendered “Espere grandes coisas de Deus; tente grandes coisas para Deus”.
